All functions

Position a fitted surface against placebo (sea level)

Compare bootstrapped pooling with the fitted surface

Cycle consistency: do the comparisons agree around closed loops?

Example head-to-head comparisons: a simulated statin network
example_truth
Generating truth of the example network

Fit the relative direct-effect surface

Plot the one-dimensional direct-effect surface
plot_network()
Plot the evidence network
plot_sea_level()
Plot the surface positioned against sea level
pool_bootstrap()
Pool comparative estimates by bootstrapped mean across trials
pool_meta()
Pool comparative estimates by inverse-variance meta-analysis

Simulate a direct-effect network with known truth
